svg.title: The dates that matter for coffee
svg.desc: Cutoff 31 December 2020; entry into force 29 June 2023; dates amended December 2025; application 30 December 2026 and 30 June 2027. Milestones are not spaced to scale.
svg.text: The dates that matter for coffee
Green and roasted coffee • legal status checked 19 October 2026
Later forest-to-agriculture conversion fails the coffee test.
Entry into force is distinct from main obligations applying.
Revises obligations and delays application dates.
Main requirements begin for these businesses.
Most qualifying micro and small operators
This is not a blanket exemption for overseas small farms.
Original timeline. Sources: EU Regulations 2023/1115 and 2025/2650;
European Commission current overview. Milestones not to scale.
